messages:
Zoë (People Ops): Quick sync 1 - new manager starts next Tue. I'm drafting a compact 'first-week for managers' checklist + a fill-in 30/60/90 sheet. Wanted to check must-haves before I finalize.

Hannah (Eng Manager): Please include: access list (repos, infra, dashboards), who approves 30/60/90, and a short list of quick wins they can own in first month.

Diego (IT): Common blockers: SSO provisioning, repo perms, org admin console. I'll pre-create the image and queue SCIM. If anything >3h blocked, ping @Diego + start IT triage with the bot.

Maya (HR): Add benefits enrollment link + deadline, manager handbook, and a slot for manager training in wk2. Also note payroll docs needed day 1.

Lina (Hiring Manager): Can we add a one-paragraph "what success looks like" for their role to the 30/60/90? Helps align expectations with skip-level.

Zoë (People Ops): Draft Day 1 agenda (compact):
- 09:00 intro + paperwork (HR)
- 10:00 IT access check & tooling overview
- 11:00 team intros + org context
- 13:00 short 30/60/90 sketch session with skip-level
- 15:00 buddy lunch / shadow
- 16:00 EOD sync with People Ops

Hannah (Eng Manager): Also add a "first 7-day manager checklist":
- Meet each direct report 1:1
- Review last 3 sprint retros + top tech debt
- Check on-call rota + runbook owners
- Identify one small deliverable to ship in 30d

Diego (IT): I'll add a link in the Day 0 email for "start IT triage" (auto-join zoom).

Zoë (People Ops): Proposed 30/60/90 sheet headers: Objective, Success metric, Owner, Support needed, Risks. Keep it single page. Lina will do skip-level signoff.

Maya (HR): I'll assign a buddy and confirm payroll by day 3.

Onboarding Bot: Reminder created: send Day -2 email; send Day 0 packet 24h before start; schedule wk1 check-in.

Zoë (People Ops): Thanks! Action owners: Diego = access, Maya = payroll + handbook, Hannah = team intros + quick wins, Lina = role success blurb, Zoë = calendar templates & 30/60/90 sheet. I'll post final packet here tomorrow morning.

Hannah (Eng Manager): I'll drop a sample 30/60/90 doc later this afternoon.

Zoë (People Ops): Closing thread for now 1 :party_parrot:
